messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to talk with me today about the barbershop booking system. To start off, could you tell me what your main goals are for this digital appointment booking system? What do you hope it will achieve for your barbershop?

Well, I guess it’s mainly about making things easier for customers and keeping things running smoothly. It would be nice if they could book their own appointments without needing to call, and maybe even move things around if they need to. Just want to make sure it helps without messing up how we do things now. That's important to me.

That makes sense! So, if I understand correctly, you want the system to make it easier for customers to book their own appointments and maybe even reschedule them if needed. You also want to ensure that it doesn't disrupt your current processes. Is that right?
Yeah, that sounds about right. It’s just important that whatever we do, it doesn’t complicate my day-to-day work. I’ve got a routine that works, so I’d like to keep it that way.
Got it! Keeping your routine intact is really important. Can you tell me a bit more about how you currently manage appointments? What does your day-to-day look like in terms of scheduling?

Well, I use a paper diary and take calls to handle bookings. I know the schedule pretty well and can keep track of everything that way. It’s straightforward for me, but it can get busy, especially if there are changes or cancellations. I just prefer the way it is now.

Thanks for sharing that! So, you’re using a paper diary and handling calls for bookings, and you feel it works well for you even though it can get busy with changes and cancellations. If you could change one thing about this process, what would that be?

I guess having a way for customers to handle their own bookings would be nice. It would take some pressure off me, especially when things get hectic. But again, I just want to make sure it doesn’t change too much about how I do things.

That’s a good point! So, if I understand correctly, you'd like customers to be able to manage their own bookings to reduce some pressure on you, but you still want to maintain your current way of doing things as much as possible. Are there any specific features you think would be important for this self-service booking option?

Maybe something that lets them pick a service, choose a barber, and see when they can book. It would also be helpful if they could cancel or change their appointments without having to call me. Just simple stuff like that.

Thanks for those details! So, to clarify, you’d like the booking system to allow customers to pick a service, choose a barber, and see available times. You also want them to be able to cancel or change appointments without needing to call you. Is that correct?
Yeah, that’s correct. Just straightforward options for them. It should make things easier while keeping my workflow intact.

Understood! Keeping it straightforward for customers is key. Are there any limitations or restrictions that you think we should be aware of while developing this booking system? For example, things like budget, technology, or specific requirements?
I haven't really thought about that. I just want to make sure we don’t change too much of what we already do. I’m not looking to complicate things.

That makes sense! So, it’s mainly about not complicating your existing processes. Just to confirm, you want a booking system that allows customers to pick services, choose barbers, see available times, and manage their own appointments without affecting your current workflow. Is there anything else you think is important for this system?
I think reminders would be good. If customers get a heads-up about their appointments, that might help reduce no-shows. Just things like that could make a difference.

Great point! So, to summarize, you want the system to include reminders for customers about their appointments to help reduce no-shows. That seems like a really helpful feature. I think we’ve covered a lot of important points. Just to recap, you’re looking for a booking system that lets customers pick services, choose barbers, see available times, manage their own appointments, and receive reminders, all while keeping your current workflow intact. If that’s all correct, I’ll note that as our requirements!
